import 'package:napi/napi.dart' as native;
import 'annotations.dart' as annotation;
import 'imported.dart';
import 'lookalike.dart' as lookalike;

export 'barrel.dart' hide hidden;
export 'metadata.dart';

part 'entry_part.dart';

/// A renamed scalar function.
@native.NAPI(name: 'renamed')
int scalar(int value) => importedOnly(value);

@annotation.NAPI()
int reexportAnnotation(int value) => value;

@annotation.Export(name: 'aliasAnnotation')
int aliasSelected(int value) => value;

@lookalike.NAPI(name: 'mustNotAppear')
int lookalikeOnly(int value) => value;

int unannotated(int value) => value;

@lookalike.NAPI()
typedef LookalikeCount = int;
